verdict.rationale: Moosend is a SaaS email-marketing platform, so publishing an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of llms.txt, machine-readable docs or agent-oriented documentation. The only related item is a marketing line about 'AI-powered suggestions' for content, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
